findings.detail: The historical help-page section requires initial quarantine for made-up contact details; the dated clarification and current instructions remove that blanket requirement for verified fictional placeholders. The section's recorded supersession resolves which wording governs.

The current instructions contain the clarification, and the earlier artifact inspection identifies the remaining stale wording specifically in the old help page; the status note does not identify which guide it means.
